purpose: upgrade CEUNIA MCP interoperability from a fixed legacy handshake assumption to protocol-version-adaptive execution
finding: Current MCP documentation distinguishes the legacy initialize lifecycle through protocol 2025-11-25 from the stateless lifecycle introduced in protocol 2026-07-28.
impact_on_ceunia: CEI-020 through CEI-023 correctly recorded blocked execution, but their fixed initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call sequence must not be treated as universally mandatory for current MCP implementations.

new_gate.step_3: if legacy lifecycle applies: initialize -> notifications/initialized
new_gate.step_4: if 2026-07-28 stateless lifecycle applies: omit legacy initialize handshake and use per-request protocol metadata
new_gate.step_8: capture raw result including isError/structuredContent where present

epistemic_boundary: The protocol upgrade is based on current MCP documentation; it does not constitute a live Serena execution.
evidence_reference: Official MCP SDK documentation states that 2025-11-25 uses the legacy initialize lifecycle, while 2026-07-28 introduces a stateless model without initialize/notifications/initialized.
next_required: Expose a real Serena MCP transport, identify negotiated protocol behavior, then execute the appropriate lifecycle and record raw evidence.
